lines.desc: A red or blue litmus paper strip (7 × 66 mm) hanging from a wooden splint laid across a beaker's rim; lift=0 lowers it into the liquid (level cm under the rim) and the soaked part changes colour: blue turns red in acid, red turns blue in alkali. anchors: tip

lines.name: lockcylinder
lines.sig: lockcylinder cx cy k in=0..1 cuts=2,5,3,6,4 lab=0 lit=key|pins|springs|plug|housing|shear|gauge|board
lines.desc: A pin-tumbler door lock cylinder cut open along the keyway on a bench fixture: the key slides in, each cut lifts its key pin, and with the right key every pin top lands on the shear line, which turns green. anchors: keyway

lines.name: lockstand
lines.sig: lockstand cx cy k lab=0 lit=board|plate|clamps
lines.desc: A display stand for a cut-open lock: wooden board, upright plate and two steel clamp blocks that grip the lock body's sides; the lock goes at anchor lock with clamp=1. anchors: lock

lines.name: loopstirrer
lines.sig: loopstirrer cx cy k stir=0|1 hide=0..8 lab=0 lit=wire|loop
lines.desc: A thin steel wire stirrer 9 cm long with a finger loop at the top, pushed up and down through a lid to mix a calorimeter's liquid. anchors: top

lines.name: loudspeaker
lines.sig: loudspeaker cx cy k click=0|1 lab=0 lit=cabinet|cone|yoke|stand
lines.desc: A loudspeaker cabinet (15 × 20 × 22 cm) held in a yoke on a 1 m pole stand with a round base, its woofer facing +x; it sends a short click. anchors: cone top

lines.name: lugorder
lines.sig: lugorder cx cy size step=0..5 lab=1
lines.desc: Wheel with five numbered nuts; a torque wrench tightens them in the star order 1-3-5-2-4 to 110 N·m, each nut turning green when it clicks.

lines.name: lugwrench
lines.sig: lugwrench cx cy length rot=deg turn=deg nut=1 on=1 lit=wrench lab=1
lines.desc: Four-way cross wrench with a socket on each arm, sitting on a wheel nut; turning the handle anticlockwise loosens the nut.

lines.name: moonphases
lines.sig: moonphases cx cy width labels=0 day=0..29.5 lab=1 lit=lamp|earth|moon|arm
lines.desc: A lamp, a globe and a Moon ball on an arm: the lamp always lights half the Moon, and how much of that half faces Earth makes the phase.

lines.name: eclipse
lines.sig: eclipse cx cy width k=solar|lunar labels=0 line=0..1 lab=1 lit=lamp|earth|moon|shadow
lines.desc: The lamp-globe-moon bench: line the Moon up and its shadow falls on Earth (solar), or it passes into Earth's shadow and turns red (lunar).

lines.name: lunchbox
lines.sig: lunchbox cx cy width open=0..1 lab=1 lit=tub|lid|clips|sandwich|apple|carrots
lines.desc: A bento lunchbox: the clips flip up and the lid swings back on its hinge, showing three compartments with a cheese sandwich, an apple and carrot sticks.

lines.name: lungmodel
lines.sig: lungmodel cx cy height pull=0..1 lab=1
lines.desc: Pull the rubber diaphragm down: the jar's space grows, its pressure drops and the balloon lungs fill — the same way we breathe in.

lines.name: luxmeter
lines.sig: luxmeter cx cy k lux=0..2000 mount=post|stand lab=0 lit=sensor|case|display|post
lines.desc: A light meter 8 × 5 × 6 cm: a white sensor dome facing +x (toward the light on the bench), an LCD with the reading in lux, ON and HOLD buttons; on a benchrider's post or its own stand, the sensor 13.5 cm over the foot; the reading eases to lux. anchors: sensor top

lines.name: magnet
lines.sig: magnet cx cy length k=bar|horseshoe lines=1 lab=1
lines.desc: A bar or horseshoe magnet on a card with iron filings and plotting compasses that point along the field.

lines.name: mainscord
lines.sig: mainscord cx cy k len=5..200 strip=0|1 lab=0 lit=sheath|live|neutral|earth
lines.desc: A three-core mains flex (7 mm white sheath; brown live, blue neutral, green/yellow earth) lying on a surface, stripped at one end with the cores fanned out and bare copper tips for terminals, len cm long. anchors: live neutral earth end

lines.name: manometertube
lines.sig: manometertube cx cy k h=0..28 lab=0 lit=tube|water|scale|collar
lines.desc: An open glass manometer tube 8 mm across and 30 cm high on a rubber collar, a cm scale etched up its front, water standing h cm in it (the pressure at its foot as a height of water); stands on a venturi tube's tapping. anchors: top

lines.name: marblechips
lines.sig: marblechips cx cy k n=1..20 fizz=0..1 rise=1..15 lab=0 lit=chips|bubbles
lines.desc: A heap of marble chips (calcium carbonate) on the floor of a flask; in acid they fizz, giving off bubbles of carbon dioxide that stream up to the surface. anchors: top

lines.name: markerpeg
lines.sig: markerpeg cx cy k tag=none|F|2F lab=0 lit=peg|tag
lines.desc: A small red peg 2 cm tall on a magnet foot that marks F or 2F beside a lens on the bench; tag=F or 2F clips on a card with the letter. anchors: top

lines.name: marketstall
lines.sig: marketstall cx cy k flutter=0..1 lab=0 lit=table|canopy|poles|crates|boards
lines.desc: A street market stall 200 × 100 × 220 cm: trestle table, striped canopy on four poles, three crates of apples with chalk price boards; flutter ripples the canopy's edge in the wind. anchors: top front

lines.name: massset
lines.sig: massset cx cy k n=1..6 lab=0 lit=masses|hanger
lines.desc: A slotted-mass hanger standing on the bench with up to six 100 g brass masses stacked on it, ready to hang on a spring or a lever. anchors: top

lines.name: mcylinder
lines.sig: mcylinder cx cy size c=blue level=0.6 lab=1 lit=cylinder|scale|card
lines.desc: A 100 mL measuring cylinder read at eye level: the reading is the bottom of the meniscus, against a reading card.

lines.name: measurecyl
lines.sig: measurecyl cx cy k ml=10|25|50|100|250 fill=0..1 c=clear|blue|red|green|… lab=0 lit=glass|liquid|scale
lines.desc: A glass measuring cylinder (10 to 250 mL, real sizes) on a hexagonal plastic foot, with a printed mL scale and a curved meniscus read at its bottom; a bench part to measure out a volume of liquid. anchors: rim inside

lines.name: measuring
lines.sig: measuring cx cy width k=cups|spoons fill=0..1.5 lab=1 lit=jug|water|marks|tap|spoons|sugar|knife
lines.desc: Kitchen measures: the tap fills a measuring jug to the ¼, ½ or 1 cup mark (1 cup = 240 ml); or sugar is heaped in a tablespoon and levelled off with a knife (1 tbsp = 15 ml).

lines.name: mechkeyboard
lines.sig: mechkeyboard cx cy k cap=0..1 press=0..1 lab=0 lit=case|plate|pcb|caps|housing|stem|spring|contacts
lines.desc: A 60% mechanical keyboard on a desk: lift one keycap off to see its key switch cut open, then press it: the stem squeezes the spring and at 2 mm lets two gold contacts touch, which closes the circuit for that key. anchors: key usb

lines.name: medcup
lines.sig: medcup cx cy size k=liquid|pills ml=0-30 lab=1 lit=cup|liquid|bottle|marks
lines.desc: A 30 mL graduated medicine cup: the bottle pours until the liquid reaches the mark; read it at eye level at the bottom of the curve (5 mL = 1 teaspoon).

lines.name: pill
lines.sig: pill cx cy size k=capsule|tablet lab=1
lines.desc: A two-colour capsule that pulls apart to show the powder inside, or a scored tablet that snaps in half.

lines.name: bandage
lines.desc: Adhesive strip with an absorbent pad, air holes and two release tabs that peel back.

lines.name: syringe
lines.sig: syringe cx cy length dose=2.5 lab=1
lines.desc: A 5 mL syringe: pulling the plunger back draws liquid into the barrel against its mL scale.

lines.name: feverthermo
lines.sig: feverthermo cx cy height k=fever|normal lab=1
lines.desc: A digital body thermometer: the reading climbs and settles; 37 °C is normal, 38 °C and above is a fever.

lines.name: bloodtube
lines.desc: A tube of blood before and after spinning: yellow plasma on top (55%), a thin white layer, red cells below (45%).

lines.name: stethoscope
lines.desc: Ear pieces on a sprung headset, Y tubing and a chest piece with a diaphragm (high sounds) and a bell (low sounds).

lines.name: mercurydish
lines.sig: mercurydish cx cy k lab=0 lit=dish|mercury
lines.desc: A thick glass dish 10 cm across holding mercury 2.5 cm deep, its mirror surface rounding down at the glass (a convex meniscus); a barometer tube stands upended in it. anchors: surface rim

lines.name: meshfence
lines.sig: meshfence cx cy k w=60..600 lab=0 lit=posts|rail|mesh
lines.desc: One run of a compound's chain-link fence, w cm long and 2 m high: galvanised posts at the ends and every 2.5 m, a top rail, a bottom tension wire and 5 cm diamond mesh. anchors: left right top

lines.name: metrerule
lines.sig: metrerule cx cy k aim=up|flat len=30|50|100 lab=0 lit=rule|scale
lines.desc: A wooden metre rule (30, 50 or 100 cm) with mm ticks, cm numbers and brass end caps, standing up beside a spring or lying flat to measure. anchors: zero

lines.name: mic
lines.sig: mic cx cy height open=0..1 talk=0|1 lab=1 lit=grille|capsule|diaphragm|coil|magnet|stand
lines.desc: A dynamic microphone: lift the grille to see the capsule cut open, then talk: the sound moves a thin diaphragm, the coil under it moves in a magnet's field, and that makes the electrical signal.

lines.name: michelson
lines.sig: michelson cx cy size d=0 lab=1
lines.desc: Laser, beam splitter, a fixed and a moving mirror: circular fringes on the screen; each λ/2 of mirror travel moves one fringe.

lines.name: micrometerslide
lines.sig: micrometerslide cx cy k d=0..10 lab=0 lit=rails|carriage|mirror|micrometer
lines.desc: A linear stage: rails, a carriage carrying a 25 mm mirror (centre 13.5 cm up, facing +x) and a micrometer head (0.5 mm a turn) it rests against, with return springs; moving the mirror d changes the path by 2d, so 2d/λ fringes pass. anchors: face

lines.name: microphone
lines.sig: microphone cx cy k lab=0 lit=mic|clip|stand|lead
lines.desc: A microphone (3 cm ball grille, 16 cm long) held in a clip on a small 20 cm desk stand, pointing along +x; its lead runs off along the floor to a plug. anchors: head plug

lines.name: microscope
lines.sig: microscope cx cy height obj=4|10|40 focus=1 lab=1
lines.desc: Lamp, stage and slide, a turret of 4×, 10× and 40× objectives and focus knobs; the view shows the cells at 10× each objective.

lines.name: microwave
lines.sig: microwave cx cy width secs=30 lab=1
lines.desc: A microwave: the turntable turns the bowl through the waves so it heats evenly; the mesh in the door keeps the waves in; the timer counts down.

lines.name: microwavedish
lines.sig: microwavedish cx cy k deg=0..360 lab=0 lit=dish|arm|pipe
lines.desc: A 60 cm microwave link dish: grey shell with a white radome cover, the radio unit on its back, on an arm from a mount pipe; it carries the mast's calls to the network on a narrow beam. anchors: top face

lines.name: milk
lines.sig: milk cx cy height pour=0..1 lab=1 lit=carton|cap|glass|milk |text
lines.desc: A 1 L gable-top milk carton: the cap comes off, the carton tips and pours a 250 mL glass, and stands back up with 750 mL left.

lines.name: mineralrock
lines.sig: mineralrock cx cy k lab=0 lit=rock|chips
lines.desc: A broken grey-brown rock matrix in three chunks with darker flecks and loose chips, the base a crystal cluster grows from; sits on a display plinth. anchors: top

lines.name: mirror
lines.sig: mirror cx cy width i=40 lab=1 lit=mirror|raybox|rays
lines.desc: A ray box on a protractor sheet aims at a plane mirror: the reflected ray leaves at the same angle to the normal, i = r.

lines.name: mirrorless
lines.sig: mirrorless cx cy k shoot=0|1 flash=0|1 lab=0 lit=lens|aperture|shutter|sensor|button|dial|flash|battery|board
lines.desc: A mirrorless camera cut in half down the lens: light through five glass elements and the aperture stops at the shutter; pressed, the curtain opens and an upside-down image lands on the sensor. anchors: lens shoe button

lines.name: mirrormount
lines.sig: mirrormount cx cy k aim=+x|-x|+y|-y lab=0 lit=mirror|mount|knobs|post
lines.desc: A 25 mm flat mirror in a kinematic mount (ball pivot, two springs, two adjusting screws) on a post and a clamping fork, its centre 13.5 cm up, facing aim; the fixed mirror of a Michelson interferometer. anchors: face

lines.name: mirrorstrip
lines.sig: mirrorstrip cx cy k type=concave|convex R=10..18 lab=0 lit=mirror|holder|screws
lines.desc: A curved strip of polished steel (8 × 3 cm) standing in a slotted wooden block, its face toward +x: concave brings parallel rays to F in front (f = R/2), convex spreads them from a virtual F behind; swaps between the two. anchors: face focus centre

lines.name: modelhome
lines.desc: A small detached house, 8 × 6 m, 6.5 m to the chimney: rendered walls on a brick plinth, a pitched tiled roof, a chimney, a front door with its step, four windows, a gable vent and a gutter with its downpipe; what an insurance policy protects, or a home's costs. anchors: top door front

lines.name: modelrocket
lines.sig: modelrocket cx cy k launch=0|1 lab=0 lit=nose|body|fins|motor|lug
lines.desc: A model rocket 45 cm long: nose cone, body tube, three fins, launch lug and a C6 motor with its igniter leads; fired, it lifts off because the thrust (up to 14 N) is bigger than its weight (0.98 N). anchors: top lug igniter

lines.name: modeltree
lines.sig: modeltree cx cy k lab=0 lit=leaves|trunk|base
lines.desc: A small model tree, 25 cm tall with a 15 cm crown, on a round wooden base; the far object seen through a periscope or a pinhole camera. anchors: top

lines.name: moments
lines.sig: moments cx cy width m1=200 d1=20 m2=100 d2=40 lab=1
lines.desc: Metre rule on a knife edge with hangers: level when mass × distance is the same on both sides.

lines.name: moneybag
lines.sig: moneybag cx cy k zip=0..1 lab=0 lit=bag|zip|tab|label
lines.desc: A canvas bank deposit bag, 25 × 35 cm, sewn edges, a plain printed number, a zip along the top with a lock tab; zip opens it to show the note bundles inside. anchors: top tab

lines.name: motionsensor
lines.sig: motionsensor cx cy k aim=up|side lab=0 lit=case|face|switch|socket
lines.desc: An ultrasonic motion sensor: a case with a gold transducer behind a bezel that times the echo off a moving thing, a status lamp, a cart/ball switch and a cable socket; face up (aim=up) or looking along the bench (aim=side). anchors: face socket

lines.name: motor
lines.sig: motor cx cy width k=motor|generator lab=1
lines.desc: Magnets, a copper coil on an axle, a split-ring commutator and brushes: current makes the coil turn; turn it and it makes current.

lines.name: muffler
lines.sig: muffler cx cy width lab=0 lit=downpipe|cat|middle|muffler|tailpipe
lines.desc: A car's exhaust as it hangs under the floor: downpipe, catalytic converter, middle box, muffler and tailpipe on rubber hangers; exhaust pulses travel along it and each part lights in turn.

lines.name: mug
lines.sig: mug cx cy k t=0..100 lab=0 lit=mug|handle|water
lines.desc: A glazed ceramic mug (9 cm × 10 cm) with a loop handle, holding water at t °C: steam wisps when hot, beads of condensation when cooled below 12 °C; the heat engine stands on its rim. anchors: rim water side

lines.name: multimeter
lines.sig: multimeter cx cy k value=-1999..1999 unit=V|A|mA|ohm|off leads=1|0 lab=0 lit=case|display|dial|sockets|leads
lines.desc: A handheld digital multimeter in a yellow holster: autoranging LCD, a rotary dial set to the unit, 10A / COM / VΩmA sockets and red and black probe leads lying in front; the reading settles to value. anchors: plus com red black

lines.name: nebulizer
lines.sig: nebulizer cx cy size on=0|1 lbl=0 lab=0 lit=compressor|switch|tubing|cup|mouthpiece|mist
lines.desc: A compressor pushes air down the tubing into the medicine cup; the jet turns the liquid into a fine mist that drifts out of the mouthpiece.

lines.name: netswitch
lines.sig: netswitch cx cy k on=0|1 lab=0 lit=chassis|ports|ears|lights
lines.desc: A 1U network switch: 24 network ports with link lights, four uplink cages, a console port and rack ears; the link lights flicker with traffic. Origin: front mounting face, bottom middle. anchors: top

lines.name: noteband
lines.sig: noteband cx cy k count=100|50|25|10 value=1..100 lab=0 lit=band
lines.desc: The paper strap that wraps a bundle of 100 notes, 3.5 cm wide, with the count, the value and the total printed on it; static. anchors: top

lines.name: notebook
lines.sig: notebook cx cy width write=0..1 lab=1 lit=page|spiral|pencil |line, line
lines.desc: A spiral notebook open on a desk: a pencil writes the given lines on the ruled page, letter by letter.

lines.name: notebundle
lines.sig: notebundle cx cy k count=0..100 value=1..100 band=0..1 lab=0 lit=notes|band
lines.desc: A stack of generic banknotes held by a paper band, 15 × 7 cm, 100 notes = 1.2 cm tall; count sets the pile, band slides the band off and the top notes fan out. anchors: top band

lines.name: notecounter
lines.sig: notecounter cx cy k moved=0..100 value=1..100 on=0|1 lab=0 lit=body|hopper|rollers|stacker|display|keys
lines.desc: A banknote counting machine, 28 × 25 × 20 cm: sloped hopper with guides, feed rollers, a stacker pocket at the front, a count window and keys; moved runs notes from the hopper to the stacker and the count follows. anchors: hopper stacker

lines.name: nuclear
lines.sig: nuclear cx baseY width rods=0..1 lab=1 lit=reactor|control rods|steam generator|pump|steam line|turbine|generator|condenser|tower
lines.desc: A cut-away model of a pressurised-water reactor station: core and control rods, steam generator, turbine, condenser and a cooling tower that steams.

lines.name: o2mask
lines.sig: o2mask cx cy size k=mask|cannula flow=0-15 lab=1 lit=mask|strap|tubing|flowmeter|float|outlet
lines.desc: A simple face mask (or nasal cannula) on a head form, its tubing to a wall flowmeter: turn the knob and the ball float rises to the flow in L/min.

lines.name: officedesk
lines.sig: officedesk cx cy k lab=0 lit=top|legs|frame
lines.desc: An office desk: wide rounded-corner wooden top at 75 cm on a steel frame with four legs, a cable hole at the back; where a monitor, keyboard, mouse or mic stand sit. anchors: top back front

lines.name: oilbottle
lines.sig: oilbottle cx cy height cap=0|1 pour=0-4 lab=1 lit=jug|funnel|neck|oilcap
lines.desc: A 5 L jug of 5W-30 beside the engine's filler neck: cap off, tip it over the funnel, and the level in its stripe drops as a litre goes in.

lines.name: oildrain
lines.sig: oildrain cx cy width flow=0|1 turns=0-8 refit=0|1 lab=1 lit=plug|sump|pan
lines.desc: Under the front of the car: the sump's drain plug comes out and the old oil runs in an arc into the drain pan, which fills as the sump empties.

lines.name: oilfilter
lines.sig: oilfilter cx cy height turns=0-7 off=0|1 lab=1 lit=filter|head|stud|gasket|plate
lines.desc: Old filter on its mount and a new one upside down beside it; the old can unscrews anticlockwise, rises on its thread and lifts off.

lines.name: opticalbench
lines.sig: opticalbench cx cy k len=100..150 lab=0 lit=rail|feet|scale
lines.desc: A school optical bench: a 1 to 1.5 m aluminium rail with a cm scale, on two feet with levelling screws; riders with a lens, a slide or a screen slide along it. anchors: zero top end

lines.name: opticaltable
lines.sig: opticaltable cx cy k lab=0 lit=plate|holes|feet
lines.desc: A 40 × 30 cm steel optical breadboard, 1.5 cm thick on rubber feet, its top a grid of M6 tapped holes every 2.5 cm where post holders bolt down; the base of a Michelson interferometer. anchors: top

lines.name: oscilloscope
lines.sig: oscilloscope cx cy k echo=0.05..0.55 go=0|1 lab=0 lit=case|screen|knobs|inputs|trace
lines.desc: A two-channel oscilloscope used as a timer (30 × 25 × 15 cm): its trace shows a blip when a click goes out and a second blip when the echo comes back; 10 divisions = 0.6 s. anchors: ch1 ch2

lines.name: osmosis
lines.sig: osmosis cx cy size k=start|end lab=1
lines.desc: Water and sugar solution either side of a partly permeable membrane: water moves into the sugar side and its level rises.

lines.name: outlet
lines.sig: outlet cx cy height k=standard|gfci plug=0|1 lab=1 lit=plate|top|bottom|plug|test|reset
lines.desc: A US wall outlet: narrow hot slot, wide neutral, round ground; a GFCI version trips when 5 mA goes missing and is reset with its RESET button.

lines.name: oven
lines.sig: oven cx cy size temp=180 lab=1
lines.desc: A cooker's fan oven at 180 °C: the element glows, the cake rises as gas bubbles in the batter expand in the heat; four gas burners on the hob above.

lines.name: overearphones
lines.sig: overearphones cx cy k open=0..1 play=0|1 lab=0 lit=headband|slider|cushion|cup|driver|diaphragm|coil|magnet
lines.desc: Over-ear headphones hanging by their band: cut the near ear cup open to see the 40 mm driver (a thin diaphragm with a voice coil behind it, in a magnet's gap), then play music and the diaphragm moves the air. anchors: near far

lines.name: padlock
lines.sig: padlock cx cy height k=locked|open key=0..1 turn=0|1 lab=1 lit=shackle|plug|pins|springs|key|balls
lines.desc: A padlock cut in half: the key's cuts push five pin stacks to the shear line, the plug turns, the locking balls drop onto the cam's flats and the shackle springs open.

lines.name: paintroller
lines.sig: paintroller cx cy width step=0..3 lab=1 lit=cover|ramp|paint|wall|handle
lines.desc: Paint roller (frame, cage, 9 in nap cover, handle with a threaded end for a pole) and a tray with paint in its well and a ribbed ramp: load it, roll it on the ramp, roll a W on the wall.

lines.name: palette
lines.sig: palette cx cy width mix=0|1 lab=1 lit=palette|paints|brush|jar
lines.desc: An artist's palette with six paints, a brush and a water jar: the brush picks up yellow, then blue, and stirs them together into green.

lines.name: pallet
lines.sig: pallet cx cy k cartons=0..12 wrap=0|1 lab=0 lit=pallet|cartons|wrap
lines.desc: A 120 × 80 cm wooden pallet with up to 12 taped cartons stacked four to a layer (up to 1.5 m) and optional stretch film; goods in bulk between factory and shop. anchors: top fork

lines.name: paperbag
lines.sig: paperbag cx cy k lab=0 lit=bag|handles|food
lines.desc: A brown paper shopping bag 32 × 18 × 40 cm with a folded top, side gussets and twisted paper handles, a baguette, celery and an apple peeking out: what you carry home after paying. anchors: top handle

lines.name: paperclip
lines.sig: paperclip cx cy k aim=flat|hang deg=0..360 lab=0 lit=clip
lines.desc: A steel Gem paper clip 3.2 × 0.8 cm bent from 0.9 mm wire: lying flat on a surface turned deg, or hanging by its big loop from a magnet or another clip (chain them at=<clip>.bottom). anchors: top bottom

lines.name: papersheet
lines.sig: papersheet cx cy k axis=0|1 pins=0|1 lab=0 lit=paper|axis|pins
lines.desc: A white A4 sheet lying on the bench (long side along x), the principal axis ruled in pencil through its middle with a cm scale, held by four drawing pins; ray boxes, mirrors and blocks stand on it. anchors: middle left right

lines.name: parkbench
lines.sig: parkbench cx cy k lab=0 lit=seat|back|frames|feet
lines.desc: An outdoor bench 150 cm long: five hardwood seat slats at 45 cm and three backrest slats, bolted to two painted steel side frames with armrests, bolted down on foot plates. anchors: seat back

lines.name: parttable
lines.sig: parttable cx cy k mark=0|1 lab=0 lit=top|legs|rails|mark
lines.desc: A small steel work stand 52 × 52 × 75 cm: square top on four legs with cross rails and levelling feet, a yellow square marked where the part goes. anchors: top

lines.name: passbook
lines.sig: passbook cx cy k rows=0..8 lab=0 lit=book|rows
lines.desc: A small bank savings passbook lying open, 14 × 9 cm: the account page and the record page with printed rows of DATE, IN, OUT and the running BALANCE (no interest line); rows sets how many rows are printed. anchors: top

lines.name: payslipsheet
lines.sig: payslipsheet cx cy k slide=0..1 lab=0 lit=envelope|window|flap|payslip|netpay
lines.desc: A printed payslip standing in its opened window envelope: company block, employee details through the window, earnings and deductions rows and the NET PAY box (2150.00 gross − 279.50 deductions = 1870.50); slide draws it up out of the envelope. anchors: top net

lines.name: pcmouse
lines.sig: pcmouse cx cy k cable=0|1 lab=0 lit=shell|buttons|wheel|cable
lines.desc: A computer mouse: rounded shell, two buttons, a scroll wheel between them, a cable or wireless; static. anchors: top front

lines.name: pctower
lines.sig: pctower cx cy k door=0..100 on=0|1 lab=0 lit=case|side|board|cooler|ram|gpu|psu|drive|fans
lines.desc: A mid-tower desktop case: front mesh, top vent, power button and lamp, rear fan; its steel side door swings open to show the motherboard, cooler, memory, graphics card, power supply and drives; on=1 spins the fans. anchors: top front

lines.name: pencil
lines.sig: pencil cx cy k aim=wall|down|flat lab=0 lit=pencil
lines.desc: A yellow hex HB pencil, 18 cm: graphite lead, sharpened cedar cone with the paint's scallop, painted body, aluminium ferrule and pink eraser; the lead's point is the origin and aim says where it points. anchors: none

lines.name: pencilcase
lines.sig: pencilcase cx cy width open=0..1 take=0|1 lab=1 lit=case|zip|pencils|ruler
lines.desc: A zipped pencil case: the slider runs along the zip, the top parts to show the pencils, ruler, eraser and sharpener inside, and the yellow pencil slides out.

lines.name: pendantlamp
lines.sig: pendantlamp cx cy k drop=20..120 on=0|1 lab=0 lit=canopy|cord|shade|socket
lines.desc: A ceiling pendant lamp: canopy with two cap nuts, cord grip, fabric cord, a metal dome shade on a threaded nipple, an E26 socket inside; on=1 lights the rim and throws warm light below. anchors: socket

lines.name: pendulum
lines.sig: pendulum cx topY length L=0.5 angle=15 lab=1
lines.desc: Pendulum on a lab stand with a protractor and a light gate: it swings at its true period, T = 2π√(L/g).

lines.name: pendulumbob
lines.sig: pendulumbob cx cy k line=5..200 swing=-30..30 lab=0 lit=bob|hook|line
lines.desc: A 2.5 cm brass pendulum bob on a cotton thread from its hanging point; it swings at its true period T = 2π√(L/g), whatever its mass. anchors: top bob

lines.name: pendulumclamp
lines.sig: pendulumclamp cx cy k lab=0 lit=jaws|screw|arm
lines.desc: A split clamp that grips a pendulum's thread between two steel cheeks with a thumb screw, on an arm that goes into a stand's boss; the thread leaves the slit's bottom at a sharp, fixed pivot, so the length L is measured from there. anchors: pivot rod

lines.name: penetration
lines.sig: penetration cx cy width src=alpha|beta|gamma abs=none|paper|aluminium|lead lab=1 lit=source|absorber|tube|counter
lines.desc: A sealed source, a sheet of absorber and a Geiger–Müller tube with a counter: paper stops alpha, aluminium stops beta, lead only cuts gamma down.

lines.name: periscope
lines.sig: periscope cx cy height up=0 lab=1 lit=mirrors|tube|eye|tree
lines.desc: A telescopic periscope cut open behind a brick wall: two 45° mirrors turn the light twice; raise it and the eye sees the tree over the wall.

lines.name: perspexstrip
lines.sig: perspexstrip cx cy k lab=0 lit=strip|ends
lines.desc: A long clear perspex strip 30 × 1 × 1 cm with polished ends, a model optical fibre: light that goes in at one end reflects totally off its walls all the way along. anchors: left right top

lines.name: petridish
lines.sig: petridish cx cy size day=2 lab=1
lines.desc: Bacteria on agar grow from specks into colonies over two days; none grow round an antibiotic disc.

lines.name: phchart
lines.sig: phchart cx cy k lab=0 lit=card|colours|numbers
lines.desc: A laminated universal-indicator chart (20.7 × 2.8 cm) lying on the bench: fifteen colour squares for pH 0 to 14 with their numbers, to match a test tube or a beaker against. anchors: ph0 ph7 ph14

lines.name: phone
lines.sig: phone cx cy k apart=0..1 on=0|1 show=home|call|msg lab=0 lit=glass|display|board|battery|frame|back
lines.desc: A smartphone lying face up, built from its real layers: back glass with the camera windows and charging coil, the aluminium frame with its buttons and antenna breaks, the battery, the L-shaped logic board, the OLED display and the cover glass; apart lifts the layers and lays them side by side, on lights the screen. anchors: top

lines.name: phonebattery
lines.sig: phonebattery cx cy k lab=0 lit=cell|label|flex
lines.desc: A phone's flat lithium-ion pouch battery: silver cell, printed label with its voltage and capacity, and the flex connector that plugs into the logic board. anchors: plug

lines.name: phoneboard
lines.sig: phoneboard cx cy k lab=0 lit=board|soc|chips|sim|motor|speaker|usb
lines.desc: A phone's L-shaped logic board: the processor under its shield can, storage, modem and power chips, the SIM reader, vibration motor, loudspeaker and the USB-C port. anchors: plug usb sim

lines.name: phonemast
lines.sig: phonemast cx cy k h=1500..4000 phone=0..360 call=0|1 lab=0 lit=pole|antenna|radio|dish|ladder|light|base
lines.desc: A 30 m steel mobile monopole: three sectors of two panel antennas with their radios on the head frame, a microwave dish, a cable ladder and a red aircraft light; the sector facing the phone lights and sends radio waves to it. anchors: base port dish head top

lines.name: phonestand
lines.sig: phonestand cx cy k lab=0 lit=base|feet|post|saddle
lines.desc: A headphone stand: a weighted base slab on rubber feet, a post and a padded saddle on top that the headband rests on. anchors: saddle

lines.name: photocell
lines.sig: photocell cx cy k flow=0|1 lab=0 lit=bulb|cathode|anode|socket|stand
lines.desc: A vacuum photocell: a 4 × 8 cm glass bulb with a curved potassium cathode facing +x and a wire anode, in a black socket on a stand with + and − terminals, cathode 13.5 cm up; flow=1 shows electrons freed by the light crossing to the anode. anchors: beam plus minus

lines.name: photoelectric
lines.sig: photoelectric cx cy size color=red|green|blue|uv lab=1
lines.desc: A photocell under coloured light: red frees no electrons however bright; green, blue and UV do, with more energy the bluer the light.

lines.name: pillbox
lines.sig: pillbox cx cy length open=none|Mon-AM…Sun-PM lab=0 lit=lid|pills|tray
lines.desc: A weekly pill organiser: fourteen compartments, Monday to Sunday, AM at the front and PM at the back, each with its own hinged lid.

lines.name: pinhole
lines.sig: pinhole cx cy width d=25 lab=1 lit=camera|screen|candle
lines.desc: A candle and a pinhole camera cut open: rays cross at the hole, so the image on the paper screen is upside down and h × 15 cm ÷ d tall.

lines.name: pinholecamera
lines.sig: pinholecamera cx cy k d=15..100 lab=0 lit=camera|screen|pinhole
lines.desc: A 15 × 10 × 10 cm box pinhole camera, near side cut away: the pinhole in its +x end (light from +x) and a tracing-paper screen at the −x end showing the upside-down image of a candle d cm in front, 12.5 × 14.6 ÷ d cm tall. anchors: pinhole screen

lines.name: pinpadlock
lines.sig: pinpadlock cx cy k key=0..1 turn=0|1 clamp=0|1 lab=0 lit=body|shackle|plug|pins|springs|key|balls
lines.desc: A laminated pin-tumbler padlock cut open: the key slides in (key 0..1) and lines its five pin stacks up on the shear line, turn=1 turns the plug 90°, the balls drop and the shackle pops up 1.1 cm; place it in a lockstand with clamp=1. anchors: top keyway

lines.name: pipetee
lines.sig: pipetee cx cy k len=5..60 lab=0 lit=pipe|tee
lines.desc: A 1 cm steel air line len cm long ending in a tee fitting: threaded pipe ends, beaded tee, a hex plug on its far end and a threaded branch pointing up for a pressure gauge. anchors: top end

lines.name: pipettebulb
lines.sig: pipettebulb cx cy k ml=10|25 fill=0..1 aim=down|flat c=clear|… lab=0 lit=pipette|bulb|liquid
lines.desc: A glass volumetric pipette (10 or 25 mL, real size) with its ring mark and a red rubber pipette filler on top, drawing up liquid to the ring; hanging tip down or lying flat. anchors: top

lines.name: pipevalve
lines.sig: pipevalve cx cy width open=0-1 lab=1 lit=valve|gauge|tee
lines.desc: Flanged pipe on saddle supports with a gate valve (red handwheel, rising stem), a tee branch and a pressure gauge: open the valve, the gate lifts, water flows and the gauge drops a little.

lines.name: piston
lines.sig: piston cx cy height k=burn run=0|1 stroke=1..4 lab=1 lit=piston|rod|crank|intake|exhaust|plug|cams
lines.desc: A single-cylinder four-stroke engine cut in half: the crank drives the piston, the half-speed cams open the intake and exhaust valves, the plug fires the squeezed mixture.

lines.name: pistoncylinder
lines.sig: pistoncylinder cx cy k v=30..140 pin=0|1 lab=0 lit=cylinder|piston|gas|pin|scale
lines.desc: A glass gas cylinder with a sealed steel piston, its rod and a platform for masses: the trapped air's volume (mL, on the scale) moves the piston up or down; a red pin locks it at a fixed volume. anchors: platform port rim

lines.name: pivottower
lines.sig: pivottower cx cy k lab=0 lit=foot|column|tip
lines.desc: The pivot tower a gyroscope rests on: a heavy round iron foot 5 cm across, a steel column and a pointed tip 12 cm up; static. anchors: tip

lines.name: planemirror
lines.sig: planemirror cx cy k lab=0 lit=mirror|feet
lines.desc: A plane glass mirror 15 × 5 cm, silvered on the back, standing in two slotted feet on a sheet; its origin is the reflecting (silvered) line, where the mirror line is drawn; it faces +y. anchors: face top

lines.name: planet
lines.sig: planet cx cy r k=mercury|venus|earth|mars|jupiter|saturn|uranus|neptune|moon spin=0|1 lab=1 lit=ball|axis|stand|rings
lines.desc: One planet or the Moon as a model on a stand, its axis at the true tilt; spin=1 turns it one hour of its day per second.

lines.name: plankrider
lines.sig: plankrider cx cy k n=0..8 x=-40..60 lab=0 lit=rider
lines.desc: A red rider that clamps the lever plank and carries slotted 250 g masses on its stem; it slides along the plank (x). anchors: top

lines.name: plasticball
lines.sig: plasticball cx cy k c=orange|yellow|red|blue|white water=0|1 lab=0 lit=ball
lines.desc: A hollow plastic ball 5 cm across (33 g, 0.5 g/cm³) that rests on a surface, or drops into water and bobs into place floating exactly half under. anchors: top

lines.name: plotcompass
lines.sig: plotcompass cx cy k deg=0..360 lab=0 lit=case|needle
lines.desc: A 2 cm plotting compass on the bench: clear case, a card with N E S W, a needle with a red north half that swings to deg (the bench heading of the north end, 0 = +x, 90 = +y) and settles with a small overshoot. anchors: none

lines.name: plug
lines.sig: plug cx cy height k=plug|socket in=0|1 sw=0|1 lab=1 lit=plug|socket|switch|earth|live|neutral
lines.desc: A three-pin plug going into a switched wall socket: brass contacts grip the pins, earth connects first, and the switch breaks the live wire.

lines.name: plug3
lines.sig: plug3 cx cy size k=uk|india lab=1
lines.desc: A plug opened up: brown live through the fuse to the right pin, blue neutral left, green/yellow earth to the top pin, the cord held by a grip.

lines.name: plug3pin
lines.sig: plug3pin cx cy k kind=uk|india lab=0 lit=case|pins|fuse|grip|live|neutral|earth
lines.desc: A three-pin mains plug with its cover off, lying on its pins: UK (square pins, brown live through a 13 A fuse, blue neutral, green/yellow earth) or India (round pins, no fuse); each wire on its terminal screw, the cord in its grip. anchors: cord

lines.name: plunger
lines.sig: plunger cx cy height k=sink|toilet strokes=0-6 lab=1 lit=plunger|cup|water|clog|trap
lines.desc: A cup plunger sealed over a blocked sink drain: each push sends a pulse of water at the clog in the trap, each pull sucks it back, until the clog is carried away and the sink drains.

lines.name: podium
lines.sig: podium cx cy width flags=0..1 lab=1 lit=first|second|third|flags |first, second, third
lines.desc: A model of a winners' podium on its stage: 1st in the middle and highest, 2nd on the left, 3rd on the right, and the three flags rising behind them.

lines.name: polarfilter
lines.sig: polarfilter cx cy k deg=0..360 mount=post|stand lab=0 lit=filter|ring|scale|post
lines.desc: A polarising filter 8 cm across in a rotating ring mount with a degree scale, on a benchrider's post or its own stand; its centre 13.5 cm over the foot, light travels −x; deg turns the pass direction. anchors: centre top

lines.name: polarisation
lines.sig: polarisation cx cy width angle=0 lab=1
lines.desc: Two polarising filters: turn the second and the light through falls as cos²θ, to nothing at 90°.

lines.name: polythenerod
lines.sig: polythenerod cx cy k aim=x|flat d=0..50 charge=0|1 lab=0 lit=rod|charge
lines.desc: A 30 cm polythene rod, rubbed with a cloth so it is negatively charged, held level with its tip near or touching a cap; it moves in and out along its length. anchors: tip

lines.name: pool
lines.sig: pool cx cy width at=0..50 lab=1 lit=blocks|ropes|swimmer|ladder
lines.desc: A model of a 50 m pool: eight 2.5 m lanes with lane lines, lane ropes, starting blocks and a ladder; a swimmer swims a length of lane 4.

lines.name: powerdrill
lines.sig: powerdrill cx cy k aim=wall|down spin=0|1 lab=0 lit=bit|chuck|body|battery|trigger
lines.desc: An 18 V cordless drill with a 6 mm bit in a keyless chuck, clutch ring, motor body with vents, trigger and a slide-on battery; the bit's point is the origin, aim says where it drills, spin runs the chuck. anchors: none

lines.name: powerline
lines.sig: powerline x1 x2 baseY height load=0-100 flow=1 lab=1 lit=tower|arm|insulator|wire|earthwire
lines.desc: Two steel pylons carrying a 132 kV line: glass insulators keep the voltage off the steel, and the wires sag lower as the current heats them.

lines.name: powerpack
lines.sig: powerpack cx cy k on=0|1 v=0..12 lab=0 lit=case|display|knob|terminals
lines.desc: A small school DC power pack 7 × 5.6 × 4.7 cm: grey case, green LCD showing the volts, a knurled voltage knob with a 0–12 V scale, a power lamp and red + and black − terminals on the front edge; on=0 it is off. anchors: plus minus

lines.name: powerplant
lines.sig: powerplant cx cy width run=0|1 load=0-100 lab=1 lit=coal|boiler|turbine|generator|tower|chimney|transformer
lines.desc: A coal power station: coal burns in the boiler, its steam spins the turbine and generator, the cooling tower gets rid of the spare heat as a white plume, and a transformer sends the power out.

lines.name: powersupply
lines.sig: powersupply cx cy k kind=dc|hv v=0.. a=0.. on=0|1 lab=0 lit=case|display|knobs|switch|terminals
lines.desc: A bench power supply 20 × 15 × 8 cm: green volt and amp displays, voltage and current knobs, a power switch and lamp, red + and black − output posts (kind=hv: a laser tube's high-voltage supply in kV and mA). anchors: plus minus

lines.name: ppe
lines.sig: ppe cx cy size k=gloves|mask|gown|goggles step=0..4 lab=1 lit=gown|mask|goggles|gloves|box|gel
lines.desc: Protective gear laid out in the order it goes on: gown, mask, goggles, gloves; each lifts and lights in turn.

lines.name: precipitate
lines.sig: precipitate cx cy size c=yellow|white|blue|brown|green t=0..1 lab=1 lit=tube|dropper|solid|stand |text
lines.desc: Two clear solutions meet in a test tube and an insoluble solid forms as a cloud, then settles to the bottom as a precipitate.

lines.name: pressure
lines.sig: pressure cx cy width k=depth|barometer level=28 p=101.3 lab=1 lit=can|tray|tap|stand|dish|scale
lines.desc: A can kept full by a tap with spouts at three depths: water leaves at √(2gh), so the deeper jets go faster and further; or Torricelli's mercury barometer.

lines.name: pressuregauge
lines.sig: pressuregauge cx cy k bar=0..10 lab=0 lit=case|dial|needle|stem
lines.desc: A Bourdon-tube pressure gauge 0–10 bar, 10 cm across: steel case, white dial with a red band from 8 bar, a needle that swings to the reading and settles, a brass stem and hex below that screws into a tee or a cylinder. anchors: none

lines.name: prism
lines.sig: prism cx cy size i=54 lab=1 lit=prism|raybox|screen|table
lines.desc: Ray box, a flint prism on a turntable and a screen: white light splits into red (bent least) through violet (bent most); turn the table to minimum deviation.

lines.name: projectile
lines.sig: projectile cx cy width angle=45 v=2.6 fire=1 lab=1 lit=launcher|path|rule
lines.desc: A spring launcher fires a ball across the bench: steady sideways speed, changing upward speed, a parabola; the landing place shows how range depends on angle.

lines.name: protractorplate
lines.sig: protractorplate cx cy k lab=0 lit=plate|scale|pivot
lines.desc: A clear half-disc protractor 15 cm across, standing behind a pendulum's pivot in the swing plane, 0° straight down and 90° at each side, ticks every 5°; it reads the angle the pendulum is let go from. anchors: centre

lines.name: protractorsheet
lines.sig: protractorsheet cx cy k lab=0 lit=sheet|scale|normal
lines.desc: A 30 × 20 cm paper sheet printed with a 0–180° protractor (a tick every degree), the angles from the normal in blue, the mirror line and the dashed normal; a plane mirror stands on its mirror line. anchors: centre normal

lines.name: ptrap
lines.sig: ptrap cx cy width leak=1 lab=1 lit=tailpipe|trap|seal|nut|arm|bucket
lines.desc: Under-sink drain cut open: tailpipe, J-bend holding its water seal, slip nuts with washers, trap arm into the wall; a loose nut drips into a bucket until it is tightened.

lines.name: pulley
lines.sig: pulley cx topY size k=fixed|movable load=0.4 lab=1 lit=meter|load|pulley|winch
lines.desc: Pulley on a lab stand with a winch, a newton meter in the string and slotted masses: one strand lifts the weight; a movable pulley's two strands halve it.

lines.name: pulleywheel
lines.sig: pulleywheel cx cy k kind=fixed|movable pull=0..100 rope=0..60 lab=0 lit=wheel|block|axle|rope
lines.desc: A 5 cm brass pulley wheel with spokes and a grooved rim on an axle in a steel block with an eye; fixed hangs from its eye and turns as rope is pulled, movable rides in the rope with the load on its eye and rises half as far. anchors: eye left right hook

lines.name: pulseox
lines.sig: pulseox cx cy size on=0|1 lab=0 lit=clip|screen|finger|hinge |text
lines.desc: A fingertip pulse oximeter clipped on a model finger: red and infrared light shine through the fingertip; the screen shows SpO₂ and pulse, and a bar beats with each heartbeat.

lines.name: pump
lines.sig: pump cx cy size spin=1 lab=1 lit=impeller|motor|casing|inlet
lines.desc: An end-suction centrifugal pump with its front cover off: the motor turns the impeller, water enters at the eye, is flung round the volute and leaves at the top.

lines.name: pumpplate
lines.sig: pumpplate cx cy k lab=0 lit=plate|pedestal|port|terminals
lines.desc: The ground steel plate a bell jar stands on, 30 cm across on its pedestal (3 cm high): greased seat grooves for the jar's flange, the air hole in the middle, a hose port on the +x edge for the vacuum pump, two terminals on the far rim that carry a bell's current through. anchors: top port t1 t2

lines.name: pushswitch
lines.sig: pushswitch cx cy k on=0|1 lab=0 lit=base|button|terminals
lines.desc: A press-to-make push-button switch on a small black base 4 × 4 cm with two terminal posts: on=1 the red cap is pressed down and the circuit is closed, on=0 it springs back up and the circuit is open. anchors: a b

lines.name: quadrantscale
lines.sig: quadrantscale cx cy k lab=0 lit=plate|scale|foot
lines.desc: A clear quadrant plate (25 cm) standing in an aluminium foot beside a ramp's hinge, printed with degree ticks 0–45 (numbers every 5°) round its centre 3.8 cm up; a ramp hinged there reads its angle on it. anchors: centre

lines.name: radiator
lines.sig: radiator cx cy width temp=20-110 lab=1 lit=core|cap|tank|hoses
lines.desc: A radiator with its hoses and pressure cap: as the coolant warms it swells, the sealed system rises to 1.1 bar, the cap lets the extra into the overflow tank and draws it back as it cools.

lines.name: railsignal
lines.sig: railsignal cx cy height k=stop|go lab=1 lit=arm|lamp|ladder|lever
lines.desc: An upper-quadrant semaphore by the track: the arm level means stop (red glass in front of the lamp), raised 45° means go (green); a ladder climbs to the lamp platform.

lines.name: rainbrolly
lines.sig: rainbrolly cx cy k open=0..1 c=blue|red|green|navy lab=0 lit=canopy|ribs|shaft|handle
lines.desc: A big umbrella standing upright, 110 cm across open: eight ribs and stretchers, two-tone fabric panels, a runner that slides up the shaft, a ferrule and a hooked wooden handle; open furls and opens it. anchors: top under

lines.name: ram
lines.sig: ram cx cy width seat=0..1 run=0|1 lab=1 lit=stick|chips|contacts|slot|latch
lines.desc: A memory stick: a green board with black memory chips and gold contacts, its key notch lined up with the slot so it fits one way; pressed in, the latches snap up and hold it.

lines.name: rampboard
lines.sig: rampboard cx cy k len=60..150 deg=0..40 lab=0 lit=board|block|scale
lines.desc: A runway plank on a stack of wooden blocks that sets its slope deg, a rubber stop at its low end, a cm scale along it and a protractor at the low end; it rises along +x from its low end. anchors: top bottom

lines.name: ratesboard
lines.sig: ratesboard cx cy k row=0..6 buy=0..99.99 sell=0..99.99 lab=0 lit=board|coins|digits|stand
lines.desc: A currency-exchange shop's rates board, 80 × 6 × 100 cm, on its counter: six rows of plain coin icons with buy and sell rates in LED digit cells; row highlights a row, buy and sell change its digits. anchors: top

lines.name: raybox
lines.sig: raybox cx cy k n=1|3|5 on=0|1 ray=5..60 lab=0 lit=box|comb|switch|cable|rays
lines.desc: A school ray box on its foot: lamp housing with vents and a rating plate, a slit comb of 1, 3 or 5 slits on the front, a rocker switch, the lead out through a cable gland; on=1 throws n parallel rays along the bench (+x) for ray cm. anchors: beam top

lines.name: raydiagram
lines.sig: raydiagram cx cy width k=convex|concave obj=far|2f|mid|near f=10 lab=1 lit=object|lens|screen
lines.desc: An arrow on a lamp box, a lens and a screen on an optical bench, with the three textbook rays: real or virtual image, bigger or smaller, by 1/u + 1/v = 1/f.

lines.name: rccircuit
lines.sig: rccircuit cx cy width k=charge|discharge R=47 C=100 lab=1 lit=resistor|capacitor|switch|meter|logger
lines.desc: A battery, switch, resistor and capacitor on a breadboard, a multimeter on the capacitor and a logger drawing V_C: charging V₀(1 − e^(−t/RC)), discharging V₀e^(−t/RC), τ = RC.

lines.name: readingcard
lines.sig: readingcard cx cy k z=3..24 lab=0 lit=card|clip|stand
lines.desc: A white meniscus reading card with a black band on a small stand with a sliding clip; put it behind a measuring cylinder and slide the band's top just under the meniscus. anchors: band

lines.name: reagentbottle
lines.sig: reagentbottle cx cy k glass=brown|clear cap=screw|dropper text=NaOH sub=0.1M fill=0..1 c=clear|blue|red|green|yellow|purple lab=0 lit=bottle|cap|label
lines.desc: A small reagent bottle (brown or clear glass) with a screw cap or a dropper cap and a paper label naming what is in it; a bench part. anchors: cap

lines.name: receiptroll
lines.sig: receiptroll cx cy k len=0..1 lab=0 lit=roll|core|strip
lines.desc: A thermal paper till roll 8 cm across on its cardboard core, its paper running off into a printed receipt (items, TOTAL, PAID, CHANGE, THANK YOU) lying along the counter with a curling end; len runs more of it out. anchors: top end

lines.name: receiveradapter
lines.sig: receiveradapter cx cy k drip=0|1 fall=0..30 lab=0 lit=adapter|drops
lines.desc: A bent glass receiver adapter about 10 cm long that hangs on a condenser's lower end and leads the distillate down into a receiver flask; drip=1 drops gather at its tip and fall. anchors: tip drop

lines.name: refraction
lines.sig: refraction cx cy size k=slab|bent|tir|fibre i=40 n=1.5 lab=1 lit=block|raybox|normal
lines.desc: A ray box and glass blocks on paper: the ray bends at each face (Snell's law), and past the critical angle it reflects totally inside.

lines.name: releasemagnet
lines.sig: releasemagnet cx cy k on=0|1 lab=0 lit=core|coil|arm|terminals|field
lines.desc: A release electromagnet on a clamp arm: while current flows its soft-iron core holds a steel ball; switch it off and it lets go at once, with no push (the start of a free-fall drop). anchors: pole mount plus minus

lines.name: resonance
lines.sig: resonance cx cy width k=resonance|damped L=12 liquid=air|water|oil|glycerol release=1 lab=1 lit=fork|tube|meter|spring|logger
lines.desc: A tuning fork over an air column in water gets loud when the column's own note matches it (resonance); a spring and mass dipped in air, water, oil or glycerol shows light, critical and heavy damping.

lines.name: resonancetube
lines.sig: resonancetube cx cy k L=5..55 lab=0 lit=tube|scale|water
lines.desc: A glass tube 60 cm long, open at both ends, standing in a jar of water; sliding it sets the air column L above the water, whose own note v/4(L + e) rings with a 512 Hz fork at L = 15.9 cm. anchors: top foot

lines.name: retortstand
lines.sig: retortstand cx cy k cz=10..55 reach=6..20 lab=0 lit=base|rod|boss|clamp
lines.desc: A retort stand: a cast base, a 60 cm rod, a boss head and a clamp that holds a flask neck, a tube or a thermometer at any height over the bench. anchors: clamp top

lines.name: ricebowl
lines.sig: ricebowl cx cy size temp=20..100 lab=1 lit=bowl|rice|spoon
lines.desc: A blue porcelain bowl heaped with steaming white rice: as the rice cools toward the set temperature the steam thins out.

lines.name: ricesack
lines.sig: ricesack cx cy k kg=5|10|25 lab=0 lit=sack|top|print
lines.desc: A stitched woven sack of rice, 35 × 15 × 55 cm, folded and sewn at the top, the weight printed plainly on the front; a bulk grocery item. anchors: top

lines.name: ringclamp
lines.sig: ringclamp cx cy k reach=6..20 lab=0 lit=ring|boss
lines.desc: A retort ring: a steel ring 7.4 cm across on an arm, clamped onto a stand's rod by a boss head, that holds a filter funnel over a flask. anchors: ring

lines.name: river
lines.sig: river cx cy width labels=1 years=0..1 lab=1 lit=source|meander|oxbow|delta
lines.desc: A landscape model of a river from the hills to the sea: run the years and a meander's neck narrows until the river cuts through and leaves an oxbow lake.

lines.name: robot
lines.sig: robot cx cy height step=0..6 lab=1 lit=base|shoulder|elbow|wrist|gripper|box |text
lines.desc: An industrial robot arm: waist, shoulder, elbow and wrist joints each driven by a servo, and a two-finger gripper; it picks a box off one table and places it on the other.

lines.name: robotarm
lines.sig: robotarm cx cy k tx=-155..155 ty=-155..155 tz=0..200 grip=0..1 carry=0|1 lab=0 lit=base|shoulder|elbow|wrist|gripper|box
lines.desc: A yellow four-axis industrial robot arm on its pedestal (reach 155 cm): every joint turns together to put the finger tips at tx ty tz (inverse kinematics), grip opens and closes the two fingers, carry=1 holds a carton. anchors: tip base

lines.name: robotcab
lines.sig: robotcab cx cy k on=0|1 warn=0|1 len=20..300 lab=0 lit=cabinet|door|lamps|cable
lines.desc: A robot's control cabinet 28 × 40 × 70 cm: steel box with a door, handle, vent and rating plate, a green lamp (on=1) and an amber lamp (warn=1), its cable laid len cm over the floor. anchors: cable top

lines.name: rocket
lines.sig: rocket cx cy size launch=0 arrows=0 lab=1 lit=nose|fins|body|motor|rod|pad
lines.desc: A model rocket on its launch pad: nose cone, body tube, fins, launch lug on the rod, igniter wired to the controller; fired, it rises because thrust is bigger than its weight.

lines.name: room
lines.sig: room cx cy width curtains=0..1 lamp=0|1 lab=1 lit=window|curtains|bed|desk|chair|lamp
lines.desc: A cutaway model of a bedroom: a window with curtains, a desk and chair under it, a double bed, a bedside lamp and a chest of drawers.

lines.name: rope
lines.sig: rope cx cy k r=2..10 drum=4..30 drop=10..300 turns=0..20 core=0|1 pail=0|1 lab=0 lit=rope|hook|pail|drum
lines.desc: A 1 cm rope wound on a windlass drum and hanging from it to an eye and a steel hook (optionally a wooden pail of water on it); turns winds more rope on, coil by coil, and lifts the end 2π(r + 0.5) cm a turn. anchors: end

lines.name: roundabout
lines.sig: roundabout cx cy size side=left|right t=0..1 exit=1|2|3 lab=1 lit=island|splitter|giveway|ring
lines.desc: A model roundabout: cars give way to traffic already on the ring, go round clockwise (driving on the left) and leave by their exit.

lines.name: roundflask
lines.sig: roundflask cx cy k ring=1|0 fill=0..1 c=clear|blue|red|green|purple|… boil=0|1 lab=0 lit=glass|liquid|ring
lines.desc: A 250 mL round-bottomed flask with a long neck, in a cork ring or bare (to sit on a gauze and be clamped by the neck), holding a coloured liquid that can boil. anchors: neck clamp inside

lines.name: router
lines.sig: router cx cy width |text on=0|1 lid=0..1 lab=1 lit=lid|board|soc|wifi|ports|antenna|leds
lines.desc: A Wi-Fi router: the processor passes data between the internet port, the home ports and the two radio chips, whose antennas send it out as radio waves; lift the lid to see the board.

lines.name: rubberbung
lines.sig: rubberbung cx cy k line=0..60 holes=0|1|2 c=red|black M=0.1..0.4 spin=0|1 cut=0|1 lab=0 lit=bung|line
lines.desc: A tapered rubber bung 2.5 cm across with 0–2 bored holes: standing in a flask's neck (line=0), or the 20 g bung on a line (line= cm) whirled in a level circle (spin=1) that flies off along its velocity when the line is cut (cut=1). anchors: top

lines.name: rubberhose
lines.sig: rubberhose cx cy k to=<id>.<anchor> dx=-200..200 dy=-200..200 dz=-200..200 c=red|orange|black|grey|blue sag=0..1 bench=-100..0 lab=0 lit=hose|ends
lines.example: rubberhose 300 260 16 dx=24 dy=4 dz=-3 c=red sag=0.6 lab=1
lines.desc: A thick-walled rubber hose, 10 mm across, pushed onto a nozzle at each end and hanging between them: gas from a bench tap to a Bunsen burner, a vacuum line to a bell jar, or cooling water to a condenser. anchors: end

lines.name: rubberstamp
lines.sig: rubberstamp cx cy k press=0..1 word=paid|received|copy lab=0 lit=stamp|handle|face|pad|print
lines.desc: A wooden-handled rubber stamp with its word cut in reverse on a red rubber die, and its ink pad tin beside it; press brings it down onto the surface and up again, leaving the word printed in red. anchors: print pad top

lines.name: rubberstop
lines.sig: rubberstop cx cy k lab=0 lit=pad|plate
lines.desc: A rubber stop pad 3 cm across and 1 cm tall on a screwed-down steel plate; the lever plank's end lands on it; static. anchors: top

lines.name: runway
lines.sig: runway cx cy width land=0..1 lab=1 lit=runway|threshold|papi|taxiway|terminal|tower|windsock|plane
lines.desc: A model airfield: runway 27 with its markings and lights, PAPI glide-path lights, a taxiway and terminal; an airliner lands and turns off at the rapid exit.

lines.name: rust
lines.sig: rust cx cy length k=rusty|clean days=0-7 lab=1 lit=tube1|tube2|tube3|rack
lines.desc: Three nails for a week: in water and air it rusts; in boiled water under oil, or in dry air over a drying agent, it does not.

lines.name: salestag
lines.sig: salestag cx cy k was=0..999 now=0..999 swing=0..1 lab=0 lit=card|string|prices
lines.desc: A card price tag on a string loop with a reinforced hole: the old price crossed out and the new price; it swings on its string. anchors: top

lines.name: saltbridge
lines.sig: saltbridge cx cy k in=0..1 lab=0 lit=tube|solution|plugs
lines.desc: A salt bridge: an upside-down glass U-tube of potassium nitrate solution with cotton-wool plugs, dipped into two beakers to complete a cell; lift it out and the circuit breaks. anchors: a b top

lines.name: sandtray
lines.sig: sandtray cx cy k lab=0 lit=tray|sand
lines.desc: A steel tray of dry sand 20 × 15 × 4 cm that sits under a fall line to catch a dropped ball without a bounce; a bench part. anchors: sand rim

lines.name: satdish
lines.sig: satdish cx cy height aim=0-10 lab=1 lit=dish|lnb|arm|mount|meter
lines.desc: A satellite dish: the parabola bounces the satellite's parallel waves to one point, where the LNB picks them up; aim it off and the meter drops.

lines.name: satellite
lines.sig: satellite cx cy width rot=deg sun=0-360 lab=1 lit=bus|wings|dish|tracker|thrusters
lines.desc: A communications satellite: gold foil keeps it warm, its two solar wings turn to face the sun, and the big dish talks to Earth below.

lines.name: savejar
lines.sig: savejar cx cy k fill=0..1 drop=0..1 goal=1..9999 lab=0 lit=jar|lid|coins|label
lines.desc: A clear glass savings jar 10 × 15 cm with a metal screw lid and a coin slot in it, a MY GOAL paper label, and the coins saved piled inside; fill sets how full it is, drop drops a coin in through the slot. anchors: slot top

lines.name: scaleboard
lines.sig: scaleboard cx cy k w=20..60 h=20..60 lab=0 lit=board|scale|feet
lines.desc: An upright wooden backboard (40 × 30 cm) on two feet, with a millimetre scale printed down each side, to stand behind manometer or barometer tubes and read their levels. anchors: zero front

lines.name: scalercounter
lines.sig: scalercounter cx cy k rate=0..10000 run=0|1 count=0..99999 lab=0 lit=case|display|input|buttons|knob
lines.desc: A school scaler / ratemeter for a Geiger–Müller tube: green count display that rises as counts come in, the rate in counts a minute under it, buttons, a count-time knob and the tube's BNC input on the front (+y). anchors: input top

lines.name: scalestrip
lines.sig: scalestrip cx cy k lab=0 lit=strip|scale
lines.desc: A 50 cm white card scale strip lying on the bench along x, zero at its −x end, cm ticks and a number every 5 cm; to read how far a candle or a screen is from a pinhole or a lens. anchors: zero end

lines.name: scintdetector
lines.sig: scintdetector cx cy k angle=0..170 lab=0 lit=base|arm|screen|scope
lines.desc: A zinc-sulphide screen and a microscope on an 18 cm arm that turns round the gold foil on a degree ring, counting alpha flashes at any angle (fewer and fewer at bigger angles). anchors: pivot

lines.name: scissorjack
lines.sig: scissorjack cx cy k lift=0..1 lab=0 lit=base|arms|screw|saddle
lines.desc: A car's scissor jack on the floor: base, four arms on pins, the long screw with its eye across the middle and the saddle on top; each turn of the screw pulls the side joints together and lift 0 → 1 raises the saddle from 10 to 38 cm. anchors: top

lines.name: screwdriver
lines.sig: screwdriver cx cy k aim=wall|down|up|flat turn=0..1 lab=0 lit=tip|shaft|handle
lines.desc: A 22 cm Phillips (PH2) screwdriver: cross point, steel shaft, ferrule and a fluted red handle with a rubber grip; its tip is the origin, aim says where it points, turn spins it; `handle` = the middle of the grip, where a hand holds it. anchors: handle

lines.name: screwjack
lines.sig: screwjack cx cy k h=5..30 lab=0 lit=foot|sleeve|wheel|screw|cap
lines.desc: A screw post that props a ramp at its angle: cast foot, sleeve, knurled thumb wheel, a 2 cm threaded screw and a domed cap h cm above the bench (5 to 30); set h and the screw winds up or down as the wheel turns. anchors: top

lines.name: sealedsource
lines.sig: sealedsource cx cy k src=alpha|beta|gamma lab=0 lit=source|rod|handle
lines.desc: A school sealed radioactive source: the 1.5 cm source disc in a steel head on a 15 cm handle (rod and grip), its window facing −x; alpha Am-241, beta Sr-90 or gamma Co-60, told apart by the band and print. anchors: grip

lines.name: seasons
lines.sig: seasons cx cy width labels=0 month=1..12 day=1..365 lab=1 lit=lamp|globe|arm|ring
lines.desc: A lamp for the Sun and a tilted globe on an arm round it: the axis keeps leaning the same way, so each half of the Earth leans toward the light for half the year.

lines.name: sectorpanel
lines.sig: sectorpanel cx cy k deg=0..360 on=0|1 lab=0 lit=antenna|radio|bracket|pipe
lines.desc: A mobile mast's sector antenna: a 140 cm panel on brackets on a mount pipe, its radio unit clamped behind with jumper cables; it lights amber while it carries calls. anchors: top face

lines.name: semiblock
lines.sig: semiblock cx cy k lab=0 lit=block|mark
lines.desc: A semicircular glass block 10 cm across, 1.5 cm thick, for total internal reflection: a ray aimed through the curved side at the centre mark meets the flat face; past 42° it reflects back inside. anchors: centre curve top

lines.name: server
lines.sig: server cx cy height slide=0..1 lab=1 lit=drives|fans|cpu|ram|psu|rails|switch
lines.desc: A server rack: servers, storage and a network switch stacked in an open 19-inch frame; one server slides out on its rails with its lid off to show drives, fans, processors, memory and power supplies.

lines.name: server1u
lines.sig: server1u cx cy k slide=0..1 on=0|1 lab=0 lit=chassis|drives|fans|cpu|ram|riser|psu|rails|lights
lines.desc: A 1U rack server with its lid off: drive bays and status lights at the front, drive cage and backplane, seven fans, two processors under heatsinks with twelve memory sticks each, a riser card and two power supplies at the back; slides out on its telescopic rails. Origin: front mounting face, bottom middle. anchors: front top

lines.name: serverheatsink
lines.sig: serverheatsink cx cy k lab=0 lit=base|fins|screws
lines.desc: A passive server processor heatsink: a copper base, a block of tall thin aluminium fins the server's fans blow air through, and four captive screws at the corners. Origin: surface under its middle. anchors: top

lines.name: serverpsu
lines.sig: serverpsu cx cy k spin=0|1 lab=0 lit=case|handle|fan|socket
lines.desc: A hot-swap server power supply: a long slim steel module with a pull handle, a fan behind a round grille that spins, a mains socket and a status light on its near end. Origin: surface under its middle. anchors: socket

lines.name: serverrack
lines.sig: serverrack cx cy k lab=0 lit=posts|nearpost|frame|plinth|top|feet
lines.desc: An open 19-inch server rack, 42U: four posts with mounting holes every U, side beams, a plinth on four feet and a top panel; units go in at its front anchor (az = (U − 1) × 4.445 cm). A second copy with only=nearpost placed after the units redraws the near front post over them. anchors: front top

lines.name: sgmagnet
lines.sig: sgmagnet cx cy k field=0|1 lab=0 lit=yoke|coil|sharp|groove|field
lines.desc: The Stern–Gerlach magnet: an iron C yoke with a coil, a knife-edge pole over a grooved pole; with the current on, the field in the gap is much stronger at the sharp edge, so it pushes each silver atom up or down by its spin. anchors: gap in out

lines.name: shadow
lines.sig: shadow cx cy width src=point|wide ball=12 lab=1 lit=lamp|ball|screen
lines.desc: A bulb, a ball on a sliding carriage and a screen: light goes in straight lines, so the shadow's size follows similar triangles; a big bulb adds a part-lit penumbra.

lines.name: shallowdish
lines.sig: shallowdish cx cy k clips=0..12 lab=0 lit=dish|clips
lines.desc: A small shallow glass dish 9 cm across and 1.5 cm deep (a petri dish base) with up to 12 steel paper clips lying in a heap on its floor, for an electromagnet to pick up. anchors: rim inside

lines.name: sharecert
lines.sig: sharecert cx cy k shares=1..9999 lab=0 lit=frame|certificate|seal
lines.desc: A framed share certificate on a wall: ornamental border, a blank company name panel, the number of shares, a certificate number and a red seal; owning a piece of a company; static. anchors: hook front

lines.name: shelfboard
lines.sig: shelfboard cx cy k w=40..120 lab=0 lit=board
lines.desc: A solid pine shelf board, 2 cm thick and 20 cm deep with eased edges, its back edge against the wall; it rests on two brackets; a part to place in any scene. anchors: top

lines.name: shelfbracket
lines.sig: shelfbracket cx cy k lab=0 lit=bracket|screws
lines.desc: A steel L shelf bracket 20 × 15 cm: wall leg with two countersunk screw holes, shelf leg with two more, a welded diagonal brace; a shelf board sits on its top. anchors: top hole1 hole2

lines.name: ship
lines.sig: ship cx cy length run=0|1 rudder=-35..35 lab=1 lit=hull|containers|bridge|funnel|propeller|rudder
lines.desc: A container ship cut out of the sea: hull, containers, bridge and funnel above the water; below it the bulbous bow, the propeller and the rudder that steers it.

lines.name: shopbasket
lines.sig: shopbasket cx cy k up=0..1 items=0..6 lab=0 lit=basket|handles|items
lines.desc: A plastic hand shopping basket, 42 × 30 × 22 cm, mesh sides and two folding handles; up swings the handles up, items 0..6 drops groceries in one by one (to compare a basket's cost then and now). anchors: inside grip

lines.name: shopcounter
lines.sig: shopcounter cx cy k belt=0..1 lab=0 lit=counter|belt|divider|scale|bagging
lines.desc: A shop checkout counter 180 × 70 × 90 cm: cupboard front and kick plate, worktop with a short conveyor belt, a divider bar, a scale plate, the till's place and a sunken bagging area; belt runs the belt. anchors: till scanner scale bag belt

lines.name: shopfront
lines.sig: shopfront cx cy k sign=0..1 awning=0..1 lab=0 lit=building|window|goods|door|sign|board|awning
lines.desc: The front of a small corner shop, 400 × 120 × 350 cm: shop window with goods, glass door with an OPEN / CLOSED card, a blank sign board and a striped awning that winds out. anchors: door board top

lines.name: shoptag
lines.sig: shoptag cx cy k price=0..999 item=apples|bread|rice|milk|eggs|tea|beans|cereal|water sale=0..1 lab=0 lit=rail|label|sale
lines.desc: A shelf-edge price label in its plastic rail strip: the item, the price, the price per kg and an optional red SALE strip; price counts to a new value. anchors: face

lines.name: shoptrolley
lines.sig: shoptrolley cx cy k roll=0..1 items=0..10 lab=0 lit=basket|gate|seat|frame|handle|wheels|items
lines.desc: A wire supermarket trolley, 90 × 55 × 100 cm: deep wire basket with a hinged back gate and folded child seat, push handle, four castor wheels; roll pushes it forward with the wheels turning, items 0..10 fill the basket. anchors: inside handle

lines.name: shutoff
lines.sig: shutoff cx cy height k=open|closed lab=1 lit=valve|handle|hose|tap
lines.desc: The quarter-turn shutoff valve under a sink: lever in line with the pipe is open and the tap runs; a quarter turn clockwise closes it and the tap stops.

lines.name: signalmeter
lines.sig: signalmeter cx cy k sig=0..100 gain=0..10 strap=0|1 lab=0 lit=case|dial|needle|knob|ports|strap
lines.desc: A satellite signal finder strapped to the dish's pole: a needle dial 0–10, a gain knob, a lock lamp and two F sockets (LNB from the dish, REC to the receiver); the needle follows the signal. anchors: lnb rec

lines.name: simtray
lines.sig: simtray cx cy k lab=0 lit=tray|card
lines.desc: A phone's thin steel SIM tray holding a nano SIM card with its gold contacts, the tray's head with the eject-pin hole. anchors: pin card

lines.name: singlecoin
lines.sig: singlecoin cx cy k turn=0..1 metal=bronze|silver|gold value=1|2|5|10 lab=0 lit=coin|face
lines.desc: One generic coin, 2.4 cm, milled edge, a plain number on one face and a star on the other (no real design); turn rolls it over on its edge to show the other face. anchors: top

lines.name: sink
lines.sig: sink cx cy width flow=0..1 plug=0|1 lab=1 lit=tap|bowl|trap|valves
lines.desc: A kitchen sink on its cabinet with the doors off: lift the mixer's lever and about 8 L/min runs from the aerator into the bowl and out through the strainer and trap; with the plug in it fills to the overflow.

lines.name: skyframe
lines.sig: skyframe cx baseY height floors=1..10 forces=0|1 lab=1 lit=columns|beams|bracing|deck|glazing|crane
lines.desc: A model of a steel-frame office block going up: columns, beams, decks, bracing, a glass curtain wall on the lower floors and a tower crane lowering each member into place.

lines.name: slideswitch
lines.sig: slideswitch cx cy k pos=a|b lab=0 lit=body|knob|pins
lines.desc: A small slide switch (single-pole changeover) with three pins: sliding the knob joins the middle pin to the pin on that side; on a breadboard it picks charge or discharge. anchors: a com b

lines.name: slitplate
lines.sig: slitplate cx cy k gap=0.1..5 slit=v|h lab=0 lit=plate|foot
lines.desc: A blackened steel plate 5 × 6 cm in a slotted foot with a narrow slit (gap mm wide, upright or across) through its middle, to narrow a beam travelling along x. anchors: slit

lines.name: slitslide
lines.sig: slitslide cx cy k d=0.1..0.5 lab=0 lit=holder|slide|slits
lines.desc: A double-slit slide (5 × 5 cm mount, two 0.05 mm slits d mm apart) standing in its holder on an optical-bench rider's post, slits 3.5 cm over the post top; swap the slide to change the spacing. anchors: slits top

lines.name: slottedblock
lines.sig: slottedblock cx cy k curve=concave|convex R=10..18 lab=0 lit=block|screws
lines.desc: An 8 × 2 × 2 cm wooden block with a curved slot sawn along its top, so a mirror strip stands in it bent concave or convex, clamped by two screws. anchors: slot top

lines.name: smartphone
lines.sig: smartphone cx cy height on=1 apart=0..1 lab=1 lit=glass|display|board|battery|frame|back |text
lines.desc: A smartphone taken apart in its real layers: back glass with the charging coil, the aluminium frame, the battery, the logic board with its chips and camera, the OLED display and the cover glass.

lines.name: smokealarm
lines.sig: smokealarm cx cy size k=ok|beep test=0|1 smoke=0|1 lab=1 lit=alarm|button|light|vents
lines.desc: A ceiling smoke alarm seen from below: holding TEST sounds the 85 dB horn as smoke would; a low battery makes it chirp with a red light.

lines.name: sofa
lines.sig: sofa cx cy width lift=0..1 lab=1 lit=frame|arms|back|cushions|springs|legs
lines.desc: A three-seat sofa: the middle seat cushion tips up against the back to show the zig-zag steel springs it rests on.

lines.name: solarpanel
lines.sig: solarpanel cx cy width sun=0-90 tilt=0-70 lab=1 lit=cells|frame|strut|inverter|sun
lines.desc: A 400 W solar panel on a tilting pole mount: its 60 silicon cells turn sunlight into current, and the inverter's watts climb as the panel is tilted to face the sun.

lines.name: solarsystem
lines.sig: solarsystem cx cy width n=8 years=0.. lab=1 lit=sun|mercury|venus|earth|mars|jupiter|saturn|uranus|neptune
lines.desc: An orrery: the Sun on a column and a brass arm for each planet; wind it on a year and each planet laps at its true rate.

lines.name: solenoid
lines.sig: solenoid cx cy k lab=0 lit=former|winding|saddles|terminals
lines.desc: A school induction coil: a plastic former with end cheeks wound with copper (27 cm long, 10 cm across), lying on two wooden saddles, open bore for a bar magnet, two 4 mm sockets for the leads. anchors: axis bore a b

lines.name: solenoidcoil
lines.sig: solenoidcoil cx cy k I=-6..6 lab=0 lit=coil|card|terminals|current
lines.desc: A copper coil of 20 turns over 8 cm, 3 cm across, wound through two rows of holes in a white card on four posts, its ends on two terminal posts; I sets the current's arrow, positive makes the +x end N, B = μ₀nI inside. anchors: a b card

lines.name: solutecrystal
lines.sig: solutecrystal cx cy k c=purple|blue|green t=0..1 lab=0 lit=crystal|streaks
lines.desc: One crystal of a coloured salt (KMnO₄ purple, CuSO₄ blue, NiSO₄ green), 12 × 7 × 5 mm, that shrinks as it dissolves while coloured streaks rise from it into still water. anchors: top

lines.name: soundmeter
lines.sig: soundmeter cx cy k db=40..100 lab=0 lit=case|dial|needle|mic|controls
lines.desc: A sound level meter: a case with a dial window printed 40 to 100 dB and a needle that swings with how loud it is, a microphone in a foam ball on top, range, speed and power controls. anchors: mic

lines.name: sourceholder
lines.sig: sourceholder cx cy k lab=0 lit=base|post|sleeve
lines.desc: A small stand for a radioactive source: heavy steel foot, steel post and an aluminium sleeve along x, 7 cm up, that the source's handle slides into and a thumb screw locks. anchors: sleeve

lines.name: spacerocket
lines.sig: spacerocket cx cy height go=1 lab=1
lines.desc: A two-stage rocket on its pad: at lift-off thrust beats weight and it climbs, faster each second as its fuel burns away.

lines.name: spacesat
lines.sig: spacesat cx cy size open=1 lab=1
lines.desc: A satellite's gold-foil body, dish and antennas; its two solar wings fold out to face the Sun.

lines.name: spacescope
lines.sig: spacescope cx cy size alt=30 lab=1
lines.desc: A refracting telescope: a big objective lens collects light, a small eyepiece magnifies; it tilts up on its mount.

lines.name: spatula
lines.sig: spatula cx cy k lab=0 lit=spatula
lines.desc: A 5 cm stainless-steel spatula with a flat 8 mm blade and a narrow handle, lying flat on a surface, to lift a crystal or a little powder from a bottle. anchors: blade

lines.name: speaker
lines.sig: speaker cx cy height waves=1 cut=0..1 play=0|1 lab=1 lit=woofer|tweeter|port|magnet|coil|cone|spider
lines.desc: A two-way loudspeaker: cut it open to see how the woofer works (a voice coil in a magnet's gap pushes the paper cone), then play it and the cone pumps the air into sound waves.

lines.name: speedometer
lines.sig: speedometer cx cy k kmh=0..120 lab=0 lit=case|dial|needle|bracket
lines.desc: A car speedometer on a bench U-bracket: 10 cm case, dial 0–120 km/h, odometer window, a needle that swings to kmh on a damped spring; its drive cable screws onto the back. anchors: cable

lines.name: spiritlevel
lines.sig: spiritlevel cx cy length k=level|tilted tilt=deg lab=1 lit=level|vial|bubble|board|foot
lines.desc: A spirit level on a shelf board: tilt the board and the bubble slides off to the high side; turn the foot until it sits between the rings and the shelf is level.

lines.name: splint
lines.sig: splint cx cy k dip=0..1 in=acid|alkali|water level=1..5 lab=0 lit=splint|red|blue
lines.desc: A wooden splint across a beaker's rim holding a red and a blue litmus strip; lowered in, acid turns the blue strip red and alkali turns the red strip blue. anchors: top

lines.name: sponge
lines.sig: sponge cx cy k aim=flat wet=0..1 lab=0 lit=sponge
lines.desc: A kitchen sponge, 10 × 7 × 3 cm: yellow foam with pores and a finger groove, a green scrub pad on top; wet darkens it, beads and drips water and leaves a puddle; a part to place in any scene. anchors: top

lines.name: spottingtile
lines.sig: spottingtile cx cy k drops=0..20 c=purple|blue|red|green|yellow|orange|pink|brown|clear lab=0 lit=tile|wells|puddle
lines.desc: A white glazed spotting tile, 9.6 × 4 cm, with three hollow wells for a few drops each; drops from a dropper spread into a puddle in the middle well. anchors: well well1 well3

lines.name: spoutcan
lines.sig: spoutcan cx cy k level=4..29 open=0|1 fall=0..100 lab=0 lit=can|spouts|sight|scale|water|jets
lines.desc: A tall can (10 × 30 cm) with spouts at three depths toward +x and a sight tube with a cm scale; open=1 pulls the stoppers and water jets out at √(2gh), the deeper jets faster and further; the level can fall. anchors: rim base land

lines.name: springlauncher
lines.sig: springlauncher cx cy k angle=0..90 fire=0|1 lab=0 lit=block|plates|barrel|plunger|ball
lines.desc: A spring launcher clamped to the bench: a barrel on a pivot between two bracket plates with a protractor, a steel ball in its muzzle; angle tilts it, fire=1 releases the spring and the ball leaves at 2.6 m/s toward +x. anchors: muzzle pivot

lines.name: springpointer
lines.sig: springpointer cx cy k drop=0..40 lab=0 lit=pointer|collar
lines.desc: The pointer at a spring's foot that reads the rule: a brass collar on the hanger rod and a 4 cm blade with a red knife-edge tip; moved down by drop cm, it settles with a small bounce like the spring. anchors: tip

lines.name: ssd25
lines.sig: ssd25 cx cy k lab=0 lit=case|label|connector
lines.desc: A 2.5-inch SATA solid-state drive: thin metal case with a label, the SATA data and power connector at one end; static. anchors: plug top

lines.name: stanchion
lines.sig: stanchion cx cy k pull=0..1 reach=50..300 c=red|blue|black lab=0 lit=base|post|head|belt
lines.desc: A queue post: weighted round base, chrome post, and a head with a retractable 5 cm belt that pulls out along +x to its end clip; join posts end to socket to make a bank or shop queue line. anchors: top end socket

lines.name: statechange
lines.sig: statechange cx cy width e=0..1 state=solid|liquid|gas lab=1 lit=beaker|thermometer|burner|graph
lines.desc: Ice heated in a beaker over a Bunsen burner: it warms, melts at 0 °C, the water warms, then boils at 100 °C; the card plots the heating curve.

lines.name: static
lines.sig: static cx cy size k=electroscope|balloon lab=1
lines.desc: A gold-leaf electroscope: a charged rod near the cap spreads the leaves; touching charges it; earthing drains it.

lines.name: steelball
lines.sig: steelball cx cy k d=1..5 line=0..100 span=0..20 swing=-40..40 z=0..200 eye=0|1 lab=0 lit=ball|eye|line
lines.desc: A polished steel ball: rests on a surface and falls under real gravity when its height z drops, or hangs on a line (two threads with span) and swings at its true period T = 2π√(L/g). anchors: top bottom

lines.name: steelblock
lines.sig: steelblock cx cy k n=1..3 tilt=-40..40 x=0..200 v=0|1 lab=0 lit=block|stamp
lines.desc: 1 kg steel mass blocks (10 × 5 × 2.5 cm, chamfered, stamped 1 kg) stacked n high on a dynamics trolley to change its mass; rides with the trolley (same tilt, x, v). anchors: top

lines.name: steelpole
lines.sig: steelpole cx cy k lab=0 lit=pole|plate|bolts
lines.desc: A galvanised steel mounting pole 150 cm tall on a 25 cm base plate held by four anchor bolts, with welded gussets and a domed cap; a dish's collar goes on its top. anchors: top strap

lines.name: stepstool
lines.sig: stepstool cx cy k lab=0 lit=treads|sides|feet
lines.desc: A two-step wooden step stool, treads at 23 and 45 cm, to stand on to reach a shelf or a light; a part to place in any scene. anchors: top step

lines.name: sterngerlach
lines.sig: sterngerlach cx cy width field=1 lab=1
lines.desc: Silver atoms through an uneven magnetic field land in two lines, not a smear: spin comes in two values only.

lines.name: stillhead
lines.sig: stillhead cx cy k lab=0 lit=head|arm|bung
lines.desc: A glass still head that sits in a flask's neck: a 1.9 cm tube with a bung for the thermometer on top and a side arm sloping 14° down to the condenser; the thermometer bulb sits level with the side arm. anchors: arm therm top

lines.name: stirlingengine
lines.sig: stirlingengine cx cy k rpm=-300..300 lab=0 lit=plates|displacer|piston|post|cranks|flywheel|pulley
lines.desc: A low-temperature Stirling engine (15 cm plates, 20 cm tall): hot plate, acrylic ring with the displacer inside, cold plate, power piston in a glass cylinder, bearing post, crankshaft with two cranks, rods, spoked flywheel and a pulley; rpm + runs it as an engine, − turns it backward as a fridge. anchors: top pulley shaft

lines.name: stirrod
lines.sig: stirrod cx cy k len=10..30 aim=flat|lean deg=20..85 lab=0 lit=rod
lines.desc: A glass stirring rod with fire-polished ends: lies flat on a tile or across a beaker's rim, or leans in a beaker. anchors: tip top mid

lines.name: stockscreen
lines.sig: stockscreen cx cy k on=0|1 mood=up|down|mixed scroll=0..1 lab=0 lit=bracket|panel|rows|ticker
lines.desc: A trading-floor style wall screen on a bracket: rows of made-up company names with price and a green up or red down arrow, and a scrolling ticker strip; mood picks an up, down or mixed day. anchors: screen top

lines.name: stone
lines.sig: stone cx cy k water=0|1 depth=0..30 lab=0 lit=stone
lines.desc: An irregular granite stone about 5 × 4 × 3 cm (2.6 g/cm³) that rests on a surface, or drops into water and sinks to the floor at its terminal speed. anchors: top

lines.name: stopwatch
lines.sig: stopwatch cx cy size sec=20 lab=1 lit=hands|crown|case
